description: This file defines the ProviderStateManager class which manages the states of a provider within Orleans framework, along with related enums and exception classes.

classes.name: ProviderStateManager
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle state of a provider, allowing presetting and committing states.

classes.name: ProviderStateException
classes.description: Custom exception class for provider state errors, serializable and derived from OrleansException.

methods.name: ProviderStateManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing provider state to None.

methods.name: PresetState
methods.description: Sets a preset state for the provider, with logic to ensure valid state transitions.

methods.name: CommitState
methods.description: Applies the preset state to the current state.

methods.name: ProviderStateException (constructors)
methods.description: Various constructors for creating exceptions with different messages and inner exceptions.
